starts.how: Talk to Falion about the brawling tournament; he tells you to meet him at the Summoning Stones outside Morthal.

quests.firstStep: Go to the Summoning Stones outside of Morthal and talk to Falion there

takesYou.why: the tournament ground, where Falion summons your opponents

objectives: Go to the Summoning Stones outside of Morthal and talk to Falion there

closes: While the tournament is under way, Falion's line that opens Falion's Secret is held back; it comes back once the tournament is over

people.name: Falion
people.role: runs the tournament and summons the fighters

people.name: Erel Pure-Heart
people.role: first undead opponent

people.name: Forgotten Commander
people.role: second opponent (the objective calls it the Forgotten Captain)

people.name: Lost Blade
people.role: third opponent

people.name: Captain Grimm
people.role: the Champion, summoned last

unsure.why: the quest has a silent step before Falion's line, and Falion only offers the tournament while it's at or below that step. How it gets there isn't in these files. The Rift version of this quest line starts from a letter about the tournament, so this one may too

Falion is placed in his house; his packages keep him there for his shop from 8 am for 12 hours, a nap at 1 pm and sleep from midnight, but from 1 am for 4 hours he goes out to a summoning circle (the nearest named spot in the records is a Shrine of Mephala), except during part of Falion's Secret. Look for him at home by day

no gold, item or spell is tied to this quest in the records. The mod has a staff, the Staff of the Ashen, whose record says it conjures Captain Grimm; nothing shows whether it is a prize or only what Falion uses to summon him
